arxiv-1910-06743.title: On submaximal curves in fake projective planes
arxiv-1910-06743.creator: Piotr Pokora and Halszka Tutaj-Gasińska
arxiv-1910-06743.description: Abstract . The main purpose of the paper is to exclude the existence of certain submaximal curves in fake projective planes. This will lead to lower bounds on multipoint Seshadri constants of ‘fake’ 𝒪 ⁡ ( 1 ) \mathcal{O}(1) on fake projective planes. Keywords : fake projective planes, submaximal curves, Seshadri constants, ample line bundles AMS2010 : 14J29, 14C20 1.

arxiv-2112-10686.title: The τ → ν τ ​ π ​ e + ​ e − \tau\to\nu_{\tau}\pi e^{+}e^{-} decay revisited
arxiv-2112-10686.creator: Adolfo Guevara
arxiv-2112-10686.description: Abstract Abstract. The recent results from Belle of the τ − → ν τ ​ π − ​ e + ​ e − \tau^{-}\to\nu_{\tau}\pi^{-}e^{+}e^{-} analysis has incentivated us to make a reanalysis of a former work where the Structure Dependent parts are obtained using Resonance Chiral Theory.

arxiv-2210-12933.title: Multi-Agent Path Finding via Tree LSTM Thanks: Corresponding author
arxiv-2210-12933.creator: Yuhao Jiang, Kunjie Zhang, Qimai Li
arxiv-2210-12933.description: Abstract In recent years, Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) has attracted attention from the fields of both Operations Research (OR) and Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, in the 2021 Flatland3 Challenge, a competition on MAPF, the best RL method scored only 27.9, far less than the best OR method. This paper proposes a new RL solution to Flatland3 Challenge, which scores 125.

arxiv-2211-08733.title: Comparing Subjective Perceptions of Robot-to-Human Handover Trajectories
arxiv-2211-08733.creator: Alexander Calvert, Wesley P. Chan, Tin Tran, Sara Sheikholeslami, Rhys Newbury, Akansel Cosgun, Elizabeth Croft
arxiv-2211-08733.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Alexander Calvert, Wesley P. Chan, Tin Tran, Sara Sheikholeslami, Rhys Newbury, Akansel Cosgun, Elizabeth Croft. Robots must move legibly around people for safety reasons, especially for tasks where physical contact is possible. One such task is handovers, which requires implicit communication on where and when physical contact (object transfer) occurs. In this work, we study whether the trajectory model used by a robot during the reaching phase affects the subjective perceptions of receivers for robot-to-human handovers.

arxiv-2307-04126.title: Compactness of sequences of warped product circles over spheres with nonnegative scalar curvature
arxiv-2307-04126.creator: Wenchuan Tian, Changliang Wang
arxiv-2307-04126.description: Abstract . Gromov and Sormani conjectured that a sequence of three dimensional Riemannian manifolds with nonnegative scalar curvature and some additional uniform geometric bounds should have a subsequence which converges in some sense to a limit space with some generalized notion of nonnegative scalar curvature.

arxiv-2312-15579.title: A numerical study on the oscillatory dynamics of tip vortex cavitation
arxiv-2312-15579.creator: Saman Lak 1, Rajeev Jaiman 1
arxiv-2312-15579.description: Abstract In this paper, we numerically study the mechanism of the oscillatory flow dynamics associated with the tip vortex cavitation (TVC) over an elliptical hydrofoil section. Using our recently developed 3D variational multiphase flow solver, we investigate the TVC phenomenon at a Reynolds number of R ​ e = 8.95 × 10 5 Re=8.

arxiv-2405-18751.title: On the Limits of Multi-modal Meta-Learning with Auxiliary Task Modulation Using Conditional Batch Normalization
arxiv-2405-18751.creator: Jordi Armengol-Estapé, Vincent Michalski, Ramnath Kumar, Pierre-Luc St-Charles Doina Precup Samira Ebrahimi Kahou
arxiv-2405-18751.description: Abstract Few-shot learning aims to learn representations that can tackle novel tasks given a small number of examples. Recent studies show that cross-modal learning can improve representations for few-shot classification. More specifically, language is a rich modality that can be used to guide visual learning.

arxiv-2407-18599.title: Tight Bounds for the Number of Absent Scattered Factors
arxiv-2407-18599.creator: Duncan Adamson, Pamela Fleischmann, Annika Huch, Max Wiedenhöft
arxiv-2407-18599.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Duncan Adamson, Pamela Fleischmann, Annika Huch, Max Wiedenhöft. A scattered factor of a word w w is a word u u that can be obtained by deleting arbitary letters from w w and keep the order of the remaining. introduced the notion of k k -universality , calling a word k k -universal, if it contains all possible words of length k k over a given alphabet Σ \Sigma as a scattered factor.

arxiv-2506-10195.title: Exploring Topological and Localization Phenomena in SSH Chains under Generalized AAH Modulation: A Computational Approach
arxiv-2506-10195.creator: Souvik Ghosh, Sayak Roy
arxiv-2506-10195.description: Abstract The Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model serves as a canonical example of a one-dimensional topological insulator, yet its behavior under more complex, realistic conditions remains a fertile ground for research. This paper presents a comprehensive computational investigation into generalized SSH models, exploring the interplay between topology, quasi-periodic disorder, non-Hermiticity, and time-dependent driving.

arxiv-2510-24724.title: AmarDoctor: An AI-Driven, Multilingual, Voice-Interactive Digital Health Application for Primary Care Triage and Patient Management to Bridge the Digital Health Divide for Bengali Speakers
arxiv-2510-24724.creator: Nazmun Nahar, Ritesh Harshad Ruparel, Shariar Kabir, Sumaiya Tasnia Khan, Shyamasree Saha, Mamunur Rashid
arxiv-2510-24724.description: Abstract This study presents AmarDoctor, a multilingual voice-interactive digital health app designed to provide comprehensive patient triage and AI-driven clinical decision support for Bengali speakers, a population largely underserved in access to digital healthcare. AmarDoctor adopts a data-driven approach to strengthen primary care delivery and enable personalized health management.

arxiv-2511-01944.title: On the existence of solutions of fractional differential equations in Banach spaces
arxiv-2511-01944.creator: Dušan Oberta
arxiv-2511-01944.description: Abstract . Utilising the notion of measures of non-compactness and Kamke function of order α \alpha , we address the question of solvability of fractional differential equations in Banach spaces. In particular, we provide sufficient conditions ensuring the existence of a local solution.

pmc-11716929.title: Gendered association between life‐course social mobility and cognitive function among middle‐aged and older adults in India
pmc-11716929.creator: Soohyeon Ko, Rockli Kim
pmc-11716929.description: BackgroundIn rapidly developing countries like India, individuals undergo fluctuations in social status throughout their lives. However, there have been few investigations of the link between life course socioeconomic status and cognitive function in late middle age, particularly regarding whether upward and downward mobility exert symmetric effects. Furthermore, limited attention has been directed toward understanding gender heterogeneity within this association.

pmc-12551770.title: End‐to‐end deep learning approach for uterine artery‐ovarian artery anastomosis detection from digital subtraction angiography sequences
pmc-12551770.creator: Yu Lei, Tao Sun, Yanqiao Ren, Dongqiao Xiang, Lei Chen, Yi Li, Xiaoyun Liang, Huangxuan Zhao, Jinqiang Ma, Chuansheng Zheng
pmc-12551770.description: BackgroundUterine artery embolization (UAE) is a vital treatment modality for various gynecological conditions. However, complications may arise from the accidental migration of embolic agents into non‐target tissues through the uterine artery‐ovarian artery anastomosis (UOA). The key to addressing this issue lies in the timely detection of UOA, which is a challenging task.

pmc-12562989.title: Apply Machine Learning to Predict Risk for Adolescent Depression in a Cohort of Kenyan Adolescents
pmc-12562989.creator: Hyungrok Do, Keng-Yen Huang, Sabrina Cheng, Leonard Njeru Njiru, Shilla Mwaniga Mwavua, Anne Atie Obondo, Manasi Kumar, Elisabete Alves, Manuel José Lopes, Lara Guedes de Pinho
pmc-12562989.description: Background: Adolescent depression is highly prevalent in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Identifying top key risk factors is necessary to inform effective prevention program design. Machine learning (ML) offers a powerful approach to analyze complex multidomain of data to identify the most relevant predictors and estimate risks for mental health problems.

pmc-13264895.creator: Kyung Mi Kim, Erzsébet Horváth-Puhó, Aditya Narayan, Venus Wong, Niels Skipper, Nirav R Shah, Eyal Cohen, Henrik Toft Sørensen, Arnold Milstein

pmc-13312040.title: Methodology Assessment of Endoscopic Ultrasound Radiofrequency Ablation (EUS‐RFA) for Pancreatic Neoplasms: Results From an International Survey
pmc-13312040.creator: Andrea Lisotti, Matteo Tacelli, Stefano Francesco Crinò, Graziella Masciangelo, Pietro Fusaroli, Marc Barthet, Nirav Thosani, Maria Cristina Conti Bellocchi, Sarah Leblanc, Tawfik Khoury, Paolo Giorgio Arcidiacono, Antonio Facciorusso, Fabrice Caillol, Marc Giovannini, Lorenzo Fuccio, Jayanta Samant
pmc-13312040.description: Background and AimsEndoscopic ultrasound‐guided radiofrequency ablation (EUS‐RFA) is increasingly used; however, clinical application remains unstandardized. We assessed real‐world practice among international users.MethodsA cross‐sectional 70‐item survey was conducted. Results are presented descriptively (numbers, percentages).ResultsOverall, 91 of 175 invited physicians from Europe (74.4%), North America (13.3%), and Asia (12.2%) completed the survey. EUS‐RFA was performed by 94.

pmc-13462103.title: Optimizing AI implementation for surgery: recommendations for infrastructure and deployment in the operating room
pmc-13462103.creator: Ariana Walji, Caterina Masino, Stephanie Williams, Spencer Gable-Cook, Jimmy Qiu, Pouria Mashouri, Divya Kewalramani, Mayur Narayan, Tyler J. Loftus, Wagner H. Souza, Amin Madani
pmc-13462103.description: Recent years have seen a surge in the development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies to enhance intraoperative decision-making and improve patient safety. Yet, real-world evidence on their implementation remains limited. This study evaluated the impact of AI deployment in the operating room across key implementation domains—usability, cost, and carbon footprint—using cloud and edge-based infrastructures.

uslaw-usc-t18-s1594.title: 18 U.S.C. § 1594 — General provisions
uslaw-usc-t18-s1594.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s1594.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 77 (Peonage, Slavery, And Trafficking In Persons). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Whoever attempts to violate section 1581, 1583, 1584, 1589, 1590, or 1591 shall be punishable in the same manner as a completed violation of that section. (b) Whoever conspires with another to violate section 1581, 1583.
